in_hindi.meaning: वल्ला (वल्ला, वाला, वालाक, वाल्ले - protector) + रसु (रसु, रस, रसिक - one who has/gives)

in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who protects and provides for the people/village

in_marathi.name: Vallarasu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vallarasu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lord Vallarasu is the God of Wisdom, Knowledge and Wealth. He is believed to bestow the blessings of wisdom and knowledge upon his devotees. He is also known as the protector of the Vedas and the God of learning.
